26
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, July 28, 2015/Sravana 6, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Defence; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; Information and Broadcasting; Minority Affairs)
Total number of questions — 15
Complaints against negligence of
doctors
*76. SHRI PANKAJ BORA: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
complaints against negligence of doctors
in the country which has affected the
patients;
(b) if so, the details of complaints
received, hospital-wise, during the last one
year; and
(c) the action taken by Government and
the Medical Council thereon?
Revenue collected from FIIs and
Mutual Funds
*77. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the tax revenue
collected on account of the Security
Transaction Tax and Short Term Capital
Gains Tax in the years 2010-11, 2011-12,
2012-13, 2013-14 and 2014-15; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) the break-up of taxes paid by the
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) and
Mutual Funds in the years 2010-11,
2011-12, 2012-13, 2013-14 and 2014-15?
Launching of free medicine scheme
†*78. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a declaration was made by
the Central Government regarding
launching of a free medicine scheme in
order to provide health facility to all the
people in the country, if so, the details
thereof; and
(b) whether, inspite of launching a free
medicine scheme, Central Government has
decided that the arrangement of free
medicines will be made by State
Governments under the National Health
Mission and Central Government will
provide financial assistance to the States,
if so, the details thereof?

27
Rising NPAs of Indian Banks
*79. SHRI AHMED PATEL: Will the
Minister of  FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether according to a report, the
Non-Performing Assets (NPAs) of Indian
banks are expected to rise in the year
2015-16;
(b) if so, whether the reasons therefor
include slowdown in the manufacturing
sector; and
(c) the amount of gross NPAs,
Restructured Assets and Stressed Assets,
respectively, in each of the last three years
and that expected for the year 2015-16?
Robust surveillance system to carry
out tests on food items
*80. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in the absence
of a robust surveillance system, States are
not able to carry out sophisticated tests on
a variety of food items;
(b) if so, how the Ministry is planning
to supplement the efforts of the States;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a scheme
has been framed two years ago for this
purpose but still it is a non-starter; and
(d) whether the Ministry will now start
that scheme and help the States, if not, the
reasons therefor?
Future recruitment plan for the Army
*81. SHRI D.P. TRIPATHI: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Army is still facing
shortage of manpower in various ranks;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government has conducted
recruitment rallies across the country to
recruit personnel of other ranks;
(d) if so, the details thereof for the last
three years and the current year, State-wise;
and
(e) the future recruitment plan being
chalked out by Government for the Army?
Liver transplantation
*82. SHRI T. RATHINA VEL: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that liver
transplants in India are facing a strange
hurdle of fatty liver;
(b) whether it is also a fact that nearly
50 per cent of livers from live donors and
80 per cent of those from cadavers are
rejected because there is excess
accumulation of fat in the organ;
(c) whether with increasing obesity,
diabetes and metabolic syndrome, doctors
fear that the rate of rejection may go up
further; and
(d) whether it is also a fact that the liver
transplantation cases in India are moving
in an exorbitant rate?
Upgradation of Tripura Airport
*83. SHRIMATI JHARNA DAS
BAIDYA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
upgrade the Tripura Airport, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether Government has any plan
to upgrade Tripura Airport into an
International Airport, if so, the details
thereof; and
(c) the amount sanctioned to upgrade
the said Airport?

28
Turnaround of loss-making Air India

the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India
(AI) has been losing money on
international routes and the Dreamliner
fleet that had been inducted at a huge cost
is flying in losses on several international
routes;
(b) whether a number of

Total number of questions — 160
Scientific validation of traditional/
herbal formulations
801. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of A YURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPA THY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) how AYUSH is collaborating with
ICMR in scientific validation of traditional
and herbal formulations for various
diseases;
(b) whether any projects, in
collaboration with ICMR, have been taken
up by AYUSH; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
outcome of the same?
Compulsory teach ing of Y oga in
educational institutions
802. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: W ill the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry has any
programme to make the teaching of Yoga
compulsory in all educational institutions
in the country;
(b) if so, the incentives being offered
to the State Governments and private
educational institutions to implement the
programme; and
(c) if not, any other steps being taken
by the Ministry to motivate students to
take to practicing Yoga?
Enhancing of Budgetary allocation
for AYUSH systems of medicine
803. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) the amount allocated in the budget
for promotion of Ayurvedic,
Homoeopathy and Unani systems during
2014-15 and 2015-16, separately, State-
wise;

188
(b) whether the budget allocation made
for Karnataka in the previous year has
been utilised;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken to enhance the
allocation in these systems by
Government?
Procurement of yoga mats from
China
804. SHRI DEREK O BRIEN: Will
the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
procured around 37,000 yoga mats from
China for the Yoga Day celebrations at the
Rajpath in New Delhi on 21 June 2015;
(b) if so, the reasons why the
procurements were made from China and
not locally;
(c) the details of amount spent on these
purchases; and
(d) whether these procurements are in
consonance with Government's Make in
India campaign?
Medicinal herbs research institute in
Uttarakhand
†805. SHRI MAHENDRA SINGH
MAHRA: Will the Minister of
AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether in view of the availability
of the rare life enhancing herbs in
Uttarakhand, Government would consider
opening a research institute in the State
for research, promotion and conservation
of them;
(b) whether, in view of the limited
resources of the State, the Central
Government would provide support to the
State for  research and promotion; and
(c) if not, the ways to conserve the life
enhancing herbs which are on the verge of
extinction?
Special status for yoga college at
Munger, Bihar
†806. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
fact that there is a very old yoga college of
international level at district Munger in Bihar;
(b) whether Government has received any
such proposal from the State Government of
Bihar and if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is planning to
accord a special status to it by providing
Central assistance; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Expenditure for improvement  of
AYUSH infrastructure
†807. SHRI HARIVANSH: Will the
Minister of A YURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY  be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of Ayurvedic doctors
posted in Government hospitals and total
number of AYUSH doctors in the country;
(b) the amount spent by Government
in the last one year for the betterment of
the AYUSH infrastructure; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

189
(c) by when the 18 AYUSH colleges
are planned to be established and whether
the private sector has also shown interest
in opening of these colleges ?
Expansion of air services in Rajasthan
†808. SHRI RAM NARAIN DUDI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
expand air services in the State of Rajasthan
in view of the unprecedented rise in the
number of air travellers in Rajasthan during
the last few years;
(b) the number of flights discontinued
during the last three years from Jaipur and
Jodhpur airports together with the details
thereof; and
(c) whether the Central Government
proposes to increase the number of
domestic and international flights from
Jaipur, Jodhpur and Udaipur airports?
